This implementation follows the structure of the multi-phase optimization method but introduces several enhancements to potentially lower the objective score further. The algorithm consists of three main phases: global search, polishing, and targeted exploration. 

The approach aims to:

2. Mathematical specification
The objective function to minimize is:
    score(seq) = 2 * n * max(||self(seq)**2||_∞) / (∑seq)^2

where:
- n = sequence length
- self(seq) = full linear convolution of seq
- ||x||_∞ = sup norm of array x

Global search phase:

Constraints:

  • Random single-element tuning
